display_name: Snapdeal formula pattern — OMS ↔ Settlement Reconciliation
formula_sql:
SELECT
  o.invoice_number,
  o.charged_amount AS oms_charged,
  o.transaction_type AS oms_type,
  s.settled_amount,
  s.commission,
  s.courier_fee,
  s.type AS settlement_type,
  CASE
    WHEN s.invoice_number IS NULL THEN 'Unmatched in Settlement'
    ELSE 'Matched'
  END AS recon_status
FROM zs_observe.snapdeal_oms o
LEFT JOIN zs_observe.snapdeal_settlement s
  ON o.invoice_number = s.invoice_number
  AND s.is_active = true
  AND s.transaction_type = 'forward'
WHERE o.is_active = true
  AND o.transaction_type = 'forward';
